name: Disaster Log C
source:
"Disaster Log C-001: As of right now, September 2nd, 1:36 PM, it has been raining ceaselessly for 7 days.  Our island has never seen anything like this--at least there's no record of this much consecutive rain in the past century."

[From [url=https://sofdelux.itch.io/disaster-log-c]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“灾难日志C-001：截至目前，9月2日下午1点36分，已经连续下7天雨了，我们岛上从来没有出现过这样的情况——至少在过去的一个世纪里，没有这样连续下雨的记录。”

[来自[url=https://sofdelux.itch.io/disaster-log-c]itch.io[/url]]
